findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_wallet, send_message, inbox, deal_pay, deal_check · Private data: create_wallet, my_address, balance, send_btcz, send_message, inbox, deal_offer, deal_pay, deal_deliver, deal_check, deal_status · Public sink: create_wallet, send_btcz, send_message · Destructive: inbox.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_wallet, send_message, inbox, deal_pay, deal_check · Private data: create_wallet, my_address, balance, send_btcz, send_message, inbox, deal_offer, deal_pay, deal_deliver, deal_check, deal_status · Public sink: create_wallet, send_btcz, send_message · Destructive: inbox

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
